LanguageData.SH_Rec1: 12 months, real holidays with moods, parties and gifts
LanguageData.SH_Rec2: Weather by month and three new weathers
LanguageData.SH_Rec3: Birthdays, seasonal moods, traditions and a calendar tab
LanguageData.SH_YearMode_Desc: Which year the colony starts in. The game counts from 5500; you can also play from year 0 or year 1. Only the shown number changes.
LanguageData.SH_CalendarDate_Desc: The date in the corner (and everywhere else) shows the day and month, e.g. "December 4" instead of "4th of Decembary".
LanguageData.SH_SeasonTips_Desc: A letter when winter is coming (harvest, warm clothes, heating) and when the growing season starts.
LanguageData.SH_Holidays_Desc: Real holidays (Czech and international) give the colonists a good mood.
LanguageData.SH_Parties_Desc: A party in the evening of some holidays and on birthdays.
LanguageData.SH_Gifts_Desc: St. Nicholas, Christmas and Children's Day bring gifts in a drop pod (sweets, cookies, silver, medicine, beer).
LanguageData.SH_Events_Desc: Fireworks on New Year's Eve, fog on Halloween night, a chance of a white Christmas.
LanguageData.SH_Letters_Desc: A letter on the morning of a holiday. Off: only a short message.
LanguageData.SH_Birthdays_Desc: A colonist's birthday gives a good mood and often a party.
LanguageData.SH_Traditions_Desc: A holiday celebrated again next year becomes a tradition and gives a bit more mood (up to 3 years).
LanguageData.SH_RealDate_Desc: Holidays come on the real date of your computer (Christmas on the real 24th of December, Easter by the real Easter) instead of the game calendar. Just for fun.
LanguageData.SH_MonthWeather_Desc: More snow in January, showers in April, storms in July, fog in November … The biome's own weather stays, only the chances change.
LanguageData.SH_NewWeathers_Desc: Hoarfrost in winter, Indian summer in autumn and spring showers – where the biome fits.
LanguageData.SH_SeasonalMoods_Desc: First snow, spring in the air, warm summer evenings.
LanguageData.SH_WinterBlues_Desc: A small bad mood in the darkest month of winter.
LanguageData.SH_HD_NewYear: A new year begins: a celebration, and every colonist makes a resolution (learns faster for 5 days).
LanguageData.SH_HL_NewYear: Happy New Year! The colony celebrates the start of a new year. Everyone made a resolution to learn more – for a few days they learn faster. There is a party in the evening.
LanguageData.SH_HL_Valentine: Valentine's Day! Couples spend the day together a little closer than usual.
LanguageData.SH_HD_Carnival: Masks, music and a feast before the lean weeks; a party.
LanguageData.SH_HL_Carnival: Masopust! Masks, music and a big feast. There is a party in the afternoon.
LanguageData.SH_HD_Easter: Painted eggs and spring – everyone gets a good mood.
LanguageData.SH_HL_Easter: Happy Easter! Painted eggs, spring flowers and a good mood everywhere.
LanguageData.SH_HD_Witches: A big bonfire in the evening to chase the winter away; a party.
LanguageData.SH_HL_Witches: Witches' Night! Tonight we burn the witch and chase the winter away. There is a party in the evening.
LanguageData.SH_HD_MayDay: Couples kiss under a blossoming tree.
LanguageData.SH_HL_MayDay: The first of May – the time of love. Couples kiss under a blossoming tree.
LanguageData.SH_HD_ChildrenDay: Children get a great mood and sweets; adults enjoy their joy.
LanguageData.SH_HL_ChildrenDay: Children's Day! Today is all about the kids – games and sweets.
LanguageData.SH_HD_Solstice: The longest day of the year, celebrated outside; a party.
LanguageData.SH_HL_Solstice: Midsummer – the longest day of the year. There is a party in the evening under the open sky.
LanguageData.SH_HD_Harvest: A feast for the harvest – the fuller the stores, the better the mood; a party.
LanguageData.SH_HL_Harvest: Dožínky – the harvest festival! The colony celebrates the harvest. The more food in the stores, the better the mood. There is a party in the afternoon.
LanguageData.SH_HD_Halloween: Pumpkins and spooky stories; fog in the evening.
LanguageData.SH_HL_Halloween: Happy Halloween! Pumpkins, spooky stories … and tonight the fog rolls in. Boo!
LanguageData.SH_HD_AllSouls: Remembering the dead – the grief for those who died becomes easier.
LanguageData.SH_HL_AllSouls: All Souls' Day. The colony remembers those who are no longer here. Remembering together makes the grief easier.
LanguageData.SH_HD_Thanksgiving: A feast of thanks; a party.
LanguageData.SH_HL_Thanksgiving: Thanksgiving! Time to be thankful for what we have – and for each other. There is a feast in the afternoon.
LanguageData.SH_HD_StNicholas: St. Nicholas brings sweets – the children are thrilled.
LanguageData.SH_HL_StNicholas: St. Nicholas came with an angel and a devil! Good children get sweets – the naughty ones a lump of coal. (Just kidding, everyone gets chocolate.)
LanguageData.SH_HD_Christmas: Christmas Eve: gifts, cookies, a feast and the best mood of the year; maybe a white Christmas.
LanguageData.SH_HL_Christmas: Merry Christmas! Gifts have arrived – Christmas cookies and more. In the evening the whole colony meets for the Christmas Eve feast.
LanguageData.SH_HD_NewYearsEve: A party in the evening and fireworks before midnight.
LanguageData.SH_HL_NewYearsEve: New Year's Eve! The party starts in the evening, and before midnight the fireworks light up the sky.
LanguageData.SH_GiftChildren: Gifts for the children have arrived!
LanguageData.SH_BirthdayMsg: {0} has a birthday today ({1})! Happy birthday!
LanguageData.SH_FirstSnowMsg: The first snow of the year!
LanguageData.SH_TipWinter:
{0} is near and it will be cold (about {1}).

- Harvest the fields before the frost.
- Make warm clothes (parkas, tuques).
- Prepare heating and fuel.
- Store enough food for the winter.
LanguageData.SH_TipSpring: In {0} it will be warm enough for the plants. Time to sow the fields!
LanguageData.SH_TraditionNote: The colony has celebrated this holiday {0} times – it is our tradition now.
LanguageData.SH_YearDays_Desc: How many days one year has. 60 is the game's own year (12 months of 5 days). With a longer year the seasons, the date and the seasonal temperature run slower – a 365-day year has real months and a winter of about three months, so plan your food. Day and night stay the same. Changing it in a running game keeps today's season.
LanguageData.SH_AgeWithYear: Colonists age with the calendar year
LanguageData.SH_AgeWithYear_Desc: On: a colonist grows one year older per calendar year, so with a 365-day year people (and children) age about six times slower than in the game. Off: everybody ages as in the game (one year per 60 days) – several birthdays a calendar year.
